style: Slow realistic documentary camera motion. Keep the same scene and composition. No text, no letters, no captions, no subtitles appear.

clips.prompt: She jumps with joy, laughing and shouting into the phone, waving the paper, handheld camera
The family laughs and claps, the parents hug their daughter tightly, confetti falls, slow push-in
She sits still, slowly lowers her head and closes the laptop, the light outside the window slowly dims, slow push-in
The guard shovels snow steadily and clears a path, snow keeps falling, his breath visible, slow pan
The man presses the keypad again and again, sighs and looks at the screen in frustration, slow push-in
The lights over the empty desks switch off one row after another until only two desks remain lit, slow dolly back
The hazard lights blink, children with heavy backpacks walk out of the building toward the van, slow push-in
The young man reads the screen, his shoulders drop, he slowly closes his eyes, the screen light flickers on his face
